title: cyperella campestris var. multiflora
intro: Cyperella campestris var. multiflora, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a perennial plant that grows in wetland areas. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Marigold include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
